faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Jammu Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIM Jammu Medical Officer recruitment is 02-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Medical Officer post at IIM Jammu.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.B.B.S. degree with at least 60% marks, including completion of compulsory rotatory internship, and be registered with Indian/State Doctors Bodies.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Medical Officer post is 45 years. However, age relaxation up to 65 years is provided for retired doctors.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Medical Officer position will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 56,100 to Rs. 1,77,500 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Medical Officer post will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the IIM Jammu Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The Medical Officer position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIM Jammu located?
faq.answer: IIM Jammu is located in Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the IIM Jammu Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official website of IIM Jammu or via the direct application link provided in the Important Links section before the last date.
